mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate levels (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) compress discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS < 1.0% periods over any 3-year walk-forward window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of UNRATE > 5.0% periods (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates robust economic expansion that boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint supply-demand dynamics.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of INDPRO > 100 AND UNRATE < 4.0% periods (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signal rising interest rates and inflation concerns that compress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of FEDFUNDS > 4.0% AND CPIAUCSL > 3.0% periods (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: High residential construction activity (HOUST > 600.0) indicates strong housing market demand that correlates with elevated consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during HOUST > 600.0 periods over any 3-year walk-forward window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 350000.0) signal robust consumer demand that drives corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through direct demand-side channel.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of RSAFS > 350000.0 periods (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high residential construction (HOUST > 600.0) and strong retail sales (RSAFS > 350000.0) indicate a synchronized consumer demand surge that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through demand-side interaction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of HOUST > 600.0 AND RSAFS > 350000.0 periods (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) signals potential central bank tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL > 3.5 periods (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
